caption:
Quiet bedrooms.

A dark veined marble band, backlit between oak columns. A wall-to-wall upholstered headboard. In the guest room, vertical oak slats and opal pendants. Two bedrooms of the same villa, written in the same calm language.

Interior design & 3D visualization by KAÏRA Interior Design.
